user.title: Connect the discovered Zero instance
user.description: Home Assistant starts the connection. Select the HA user whose long-lived token Zero may use, then approve a Zero user or group in Zero. Both credentials and callbacks are configured automatically. Choose a Home Assistant URL reachable by Zero and your browser. Data, reminders and alerts need no physical voice device. Existing permissions and schedules are preserved.

reconfigure.title: Connect to Zero
reconfigure.description: Connect to Zero with dedicated voice and settings tokens, never the administrator API key. Data, reminders and alerts need no physical voice device. Credentials stay private.

manual.title: Connect to Zero
manual.description: Connect to Zero with dedicated voice and settings tokens, never the administrator API key. Data, reminders and alerts need no physical voice device. Credentials stay private.

pair.title: Approve the connection in Zero
pair.description: Sign in to Zero, verify your Home Assistant address and select the enabled Zero user or group to connect. Group connections do not change private voice-user bindings. Return here after approval.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read Zero settings. Check the server URL and dedicated settings token.
error.pairing_failed: Could not start pairing. Check both server URLs. No operation was retried.
error.pairing_fields: Choose an active Home Assistant user and complete both server origin URLs (http/https, without paths).
error.pairing_unreachable: Home Assistant could not reach Zero. Check DNS, TLS and the Zero server URL from this HA server. No operation was retried.
error.pairing_rejected: Zero rejected the pairing request. Verify this is the Zero server URL and that the server supports guided pairing; check the HA log for the HTTP status. No operation was retried.
error.approval_mismatch: Zero returned an approval link on a different server origin. Use the public Zero URL configured by Zero. No operation was retried.
error.pairing_response: Zero returned an invalid pairing response. Verify the Zero server URL points to Zero rather than Home Assistant or a proxy login page. No operation was retried.

abort.invalid_discovery: Zero advertised an invalid server URL. Configure the integration manually.
abort.pairing_failed: Could not confirm pairing. No operation was retried. Inspect Zero connections and Home Assistant profile tokens before starting another setup.

assistant.title: Zero prompt and Home Assistant access
assistant.description: Loaded directly from Zero. Saving updates Zero for all owner conversations, including Telegram and Assist. There is no separate HA prompt. Built-in tool and safety instructions remain managed by Zero. Assist delegation automatically allows conversation.process. Select allowed services or add custom domain.service values; comma-separated values are split when saved. Frigate is shown only when its services are available in Home Assistant. Disabling access blocks new owner tool calls; existing reminders remain scheduled.

data.homeAssistant: Allow Zero to use Home Assistant tools
data.assist: Allow delegation to Home Assistant Assist

delivery.title: Reminder and alert delivery
delivery.description: Callback settings for future events. Existing rules are preserved.

users.title: Bind Home Assistant users to Zero users
users.description: Select a Home Assistant user and enter the private Zero user chat ID shown in Zero’s admin page. The profile must be enabled. Its permissions, memory and conversation history also apply to Assist and Android. Current bindings appear beside user names. Leave the chat ID empty to remove a binding. Each save changes only the selected user. Zero stores the bindings; Home Assistant does not cache them.

data.chat_id: Zero user chat ID (empty to unlink)

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot confirm Zero settings. No action was retried. Check the connection and reopen Configure to read current settings.
abort.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reopen Configure before saving.
abort.no_users: No active Home Assistant users are available.

error.invalid_token: The callback token must contain at least 24 characters.
error.invalid_user: Choose an active Home Assistant user and an enabled private Zero user chat ID.
